messages:
Bea: lunchtime thought: if our tiny retrieval model ran a side hustle food truck, what would it serve? :taco:
Omar: 'Context Tacos' 10/10 branding. each taco a condensed commit message.
Lina: it sells 'Prompt Poffertjes'  tiny pancakes with seasoning called 'temperature'. very niche. :pancakes:
StickerBot: poll created -> Options: Context Tacos, Prompt Poffertjes, Micro-Mochi (short answers), Nostalgia Noodles. Vote with :one: - :four:.
ops-bot: Poll results: 1) Context Tacos 2) Nostalgia Noodles 3) Micro-Mochi 4) Prompt Poffertjes
Omar: also imagine a menu item: "Two-line CV burrito" k params, wrapped in humblebrag salsa.
Bea: weekend-mode system prompt suggestion for demos: ```system: adopt street-food hawker persona on weekends; give answers like menu blurbs, max 10 tokens, end with a food pun.```
Lina: sample output: `Context Taco: mild, memetic, pairs well with retrospective tears.` :joy:
Bea: tiny UX idea: onboarding shows a food truck illustration and a daily special pulled from recent logs. low-effort delight.
StickerBot: draft sticker: "Served Fresh: Locally Sourced Context" (internal use only).
Omar: gif idea: a taco doing a tiny sprinkle when embeddings finish. legal? ops-bot?
ops-bot: reminder: animated assets for internal demos OK; customer-facing requires brand/legal review.
Lina: if this becomes a product I call dibs on the mascot name: "SnackEmbed".
Bea: SnackEmbed is perfect. claim on behalf of my ficus.
Omar: closing thread before it turns into a roadmap. whos bringing virtual tacos Friday?
